title: Exact anomalous current fluctuations in the strong-anisotropy limit of the XXZ chain
authors: Taiki Ishiyama, Taiga Kurose, Kazuya Fujimoto, Tomohiro Sasamoto
abstract: We study spin-current fluctuations of the folded XXZ chain, which describes the strong-anisotropy limit of the XXZ chain. We obtain an exact expression for the moment-generating function of the time-integrated spin current at infinite temperature. A long-time asymptotic analysis establishes that the rescaled time-integrated current converges to a non-Gaussian distribution described by the M-Wright function. The derivation relies on a nonlocal map to the one-dimensional t-0 model and its exact spin-charge separation. By extending this approach, we also show that the dynamical correlation function of the spins summed over two adjacent sites exhibits a diffusive Gaussian profile at long times.
summary: This paper derives the exact long-time behavior of anomalous spin-current fluctuations in the folded XXZ chain. By mapping the system to the t-0 model and exploiting spin-charge separation, the authors find that the current distribution converges to a non-Gaussian M-Wright function. This provides a rigorous theoretical result for anomalous transport in strongly correlated quantum magnets.
main_problem: The paper investigates the universal aspects of transport in interacting many-body systems, specifically determining the probability distribution of the time-integrated spin current.
main_result: The long-time asymptotic distribution of the rescaled time-integrated spin current converges to a non-Gaussian distribution described by the M-Wright function.
method: The analysis involves mapping the folded XXZ chain to the one-dimensional t-0 model, exploiting exact spin-charge separation to reduce the problem to a free-fermion dynamical calculation.
model_or_system: The study focuses on the folded XXZ chain, which models the strong-anisotropy limit of the XXZ spin chain. The dynamics are analyzed at infinite temperature, utilizing the mapping to the t-0 model.
key_observables: The primary observable is the time-integrated spin current, $Q_t$, analyzed via its Moment-Generating Function (MGF), $\langle e^{\lambda Q_t} angle$.
important_parameters: The analysis focuses on the long-time limit ($t 	o \infty$) and the scaling of the current, $Q_t/t^{1/4}$.
main_assumptions: The derivation relies on a nonlocal map to the t-0 model and the assumption that the long-time behavior is governed by the free-fermion dynamics after separation.

paper_structure: The paper establishes the problem by defining the MGF for the spin current, derives an exact finite-time expression by mapping to the t-0 model, and concludes with a long-time asymptotic analysis yielding the M-Wright function distribution.
why_interesting: The exact derivation of non-Gaussian, anomalous transport statistics in an integrable quantum chain provides deep insights into non-equilibrium dynamics, which is crucial for understanding energy/particle transport in quantum materials.
